Startup brief:
We help independent clinics reduce missed appointments with automated reminders and patient follow-up.

Industry:
Healthcare

Stage:
Seed

Fundraising goal:
Expand the product and sales team.

Independent clinics lose revenue and staff time when appointment reminders and rescheduling are handled manually.

Our platform brings these workflows into one system, helping clinics improve patient communication without adding administrative overhead.

We are starting with small and mid-sized clinics and will use the seed round to expand the product and strengthen distribution.

Startup brief:
Maintenance logging app for small delivery fleets. Mechanics record repairs by voice; owners see upcoming service due dates.

Industry:
Logistics

Stage:
Pre-seed

Fundraising goal:
Hire two engineers.

Small delivery fleets track maintenance in notebooks and group chats, so service dates slip and vehicles break down on the road.

Fleetnote lets mechanics log repairs by voice and gives owners a clear view of what is due next.

This round funds two engineering hires to harden the product for its first fleets.

Startup brief:
Marketplace connecting regional farms with school cafeterias. Handles ordering, delivery windows, and invoicing. Piloting with 3 school districts.

Industry:
Food / EdTech

Stage:
Seed

Fundraising goal:
Grow supplier network.

School cafeterias want regional produce, but ordering from many small farms is slow and paperwork-heavy.

Harvestline handles ordering, delivery windows, and invoicing in one place for both sides.

We are piloting with 3 school districts and are raising to grow the supplier network that those districts can buy from.

Startup brief:
Bookkeeping automation for freelance designers: categorizes expenses from bank feeds and prepares quarterly tax estimates.

Industry:
Fintech

Stage:
Seed

Fundraising goal:
Launch integrations with accounting tools.

Freelance designers spend hours each quarter sorting expenses and guessing at estimated taxes.

Ledgerly categorizes transactions from bank feeds and prepares quarterly estimates automatically.

The seed round funds integrations with the accounting tools freelancers and their accountants already use.

Startup brief:
Noise-monitoring sensors for hospital wards that alert staff when sound levels disrupt patient sleep.

Industry:
Healthcare hardware

Stage:
Series A

Fundraising goal:
Scale manufacturing.

Noise on hospital wards disrupts patient sleep, and staff rarely have a way to see it as it happens.

Quietroom sensors monitor sound levels and alert staff when a ward gets too loud.

The company is focused on expanding early hospital adoption and will use this round to scale manufacturing.

Startup brief:
Scheduling and progress-report tool for independent tutors. Parents get a weekly summary; tutors get automated invoicing.

Industry:
EdTech

Stage:
Pre-seed

Fundraising goal:
Build the parent mobile app.

Independent tutors juggle scheduling, invoicing, and parent updates across texts and spreadsheets.

Tutorloop combines scheduling and automated invoicing, and sends parents a weekly progress summary.

This round funds a mobile app so parents can follow progress without chasing the tutor.

Startup brief:
Software that forecasts rooftop solar output for commercial buildings to help facility managers plan energy purchases.

Industry:
Climate / Energy

Stage:
Seed

Fundraising goal:
Expand data science team.

Facility managers buy energy without a clear view of how much their rooftop solar will produce.

Gridsage forecasts solar output for commercial buildings so purchases can be planned ahead.

The seed round expands the data science team behind the forecasts.

Startup brief:
Inventory reorder assistant for independent pharmacies, predicting when common medications will run low.

Industry:
Healthcare retail

Stage:
Seed

Fundraising goal:
Hire first sales lead.

Independent pharmacies often notice a medication is running low only when a patient is already at the counter.

Stockpilot predicts when common medications will run low and suggests reorders in advance.

We are raising to hire a first sales lead and reach more independent pharmacies.
